text:
Rate, review, share on Apple Podcasts and join the conversation on email.
On the podcast today: defeat for Liverpool in Turkey with Dirk Kuyt’s Fenerbache winning by the odd goal in five. Manchester City are tested by RB Leipzig but the game was ultimately settled by a beautiful sweeping move finished off by Erling Haaland.
Elsewhere, Arsenal win 2-1 in Prague, a third away game in seven days and they looked tired. Real Madrid find a way (don’t they always) in Athens and Como score nine at Lens.
Plus, previewing the Premier League weekend, with as many as five managers worried about their jobs post international break, and your questions answered.
